messages.text: Usually, the partner who invited you will set up the catalogue widget on your website. However, you can use this page choose a style, copy the code, and get instructions to add your clubs smart catalogue to your content management system.
Use this dropdown to choose the visual style of your catalogue widget. The preview below will update automatically.
This is a live preview of how your catalogue widget will look on your website with the selected style.
This is the HTML code you need to add to your website. It includes your affiliate ID and the selected style.
Click this button to copy the code to your clipboard so you can paste it into your website.
Select your content management system or website platform. Click on the logo to see step-by-step instructions for installing the catalogue widget on your chosen platform.
